text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. On my desk lay a Machan doll and 
a single letter.

"Happy Valentine's. Head to the rooftop 
right away! Okay?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Puzzled, I left the Trainer's office and 
headed up toward the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I head up to the rooftop and look around. 
However, there is no one the—
Guess who~?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hello. It's Valentine Machan. Well? Did 
your heart skip a beat?
choice_data_list: You made my heart skip a beat!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. That's the first step, right?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Lovely Chan called Trainer here because 
she has a favor to ask."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I made a bento to show my daily gratitude. 
Would you please have some?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling grateful, I opened the lid of the 
bento box to find...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-shaped minced meat rice, 
heart-shaped rolled omelet, heart-shaped 
hamburg steak... Which one will you eat 
first?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. Now then, please open your 
mouth and say "aaahn."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"This is a very important matter. Now, 
now, say 'aah.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Telling them that I wanted to savor every 
bite, I calmly enjoyed the lunchbox with 
my own hands.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
How did you like Mar-chan's homemade 
bento?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"A victory 'V'. Waking up early was worth 
it. This marks our second step, doesn't 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
However, it wouldn't be Machan if it ended 
with just this.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Could you open it for me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the present was a mini Chan-me doll 
wearing a Valentine's outfit!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
These are handmade mini-mini Chan-me 
dolls. I worked really hard sewing every 
single stitch.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Please take this as a souvenir of today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not a single thread was loose on the doll. 
I wonder how much time it took to 
complete.
choice_data_list: Thank you for the wonderful Valentine's!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's my usual way of showing gratitude. 
Besides... that took care of them.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Have you fallen properly into the 
'Chan-Ma swamp'?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
—Oh dear. That's not it? Not falling 
headfirst into the swamp...?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Too bad. Machan is feeling rather down.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan wanted to get Trainer hopelessly 
hooked on her, though."
choice_data_list: Why did you want to get them hooked?
Why did you want to get them hooked?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
One day, I found it on the internet. To 
"make someone fall into the swamp" means 
to make that person completely obsessed.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So if Machan makes Trainer-san obsess over 
her...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I felt certain I'd never be able to forget 
it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
However, it seems the plan has failed. 
Mmm...
choice_data_list: I won't forget, even without that!

You don't have to do that for me to 
remember!
It was the best Valentine's Day ever!
It was the best Valentine's Day ever!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
However, it seems the plan has failed. 
Mmm...
choice_data_list: I won't forget, even without that!

You don't have to do that for me to 
remember!
It was the best Valentine's Day ever!
It was the best Valentine's Day ever!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ――! Really... is that true?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. I'm so happy.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Do you mean being number one?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I see... Ehehe. Looks like the strategy 
wasn't a failure after all.
